issues.title: [ui-audit] tui-app-fixture blocks on read in non-interactive harness
issues.problem: tui-demo.sh uses blocking read -r; harness subprocess times out at 30s and run_audit.py crashes uncaught.
remediation_checklist: [ ] Add LI_TUI_NONINTERACTIVE=1 or stdin injection in adapters/tui.py
[ ] Catch subprocess.TimeoutExpired; emit fail row instead of crash
[ ] Acceptance: run_audit.py --target tui-app-fixture --mode ux exits 0 with status fail

issues.title: [ux-audit] TUI adapter does not execute journey steps (key_nav_help)
issues.problem: config/ux-targets.yaml defines key_nav_help journey but adapters/tui.py returns journeys: [] always.
remediation_checklist: [ ] Execute launch/tab_help/quit steps with piped keys or env flags
[ ] Populate journeys array in ux-audit.json output
[ ] Derive rubric_scores from journey outcomes not hardcoded defaults
[ ] Acceptance: key_nav_help journey status pass or fail with step trace

issues.title: [ux-audit] TUI fixtures lack error display and screen-reader plain-text export
issues.problem: Fixtures always show ok status; no LI_TUI_ERROR=1 branch or LI_TUI_EXPORT_A11Y structured plain snapshot.
remediation_checklist: [ ] Add LI_TUI_ERROR=1 branch printing structured error to stderr
[ ] Add LI_TUI_EXPORT_A11Y=1 plain-text snapshot (headings/lists not box art)
[ ] Harness captures both states; rubric error_handling derived not 0.75 default
[ ] Acceptance: missing_states empty after fixture update
